limitations: Exact file-byte SHA checks cover every raster path in the current Git snapshot.
Decoded-pixel and perceptual comparisons cover only current bytes recovered with matching Git-blob SHA.
Historical same-path versions are checked separately; they are not evidence of the current repository image content.
Perceptual thresholds flag possible matches for human review; a clean result cannot exclude severe crops or large visual edits.
perceptual_threshold: Aspect ratio within 12%; pHash <= 6 plus dHash <= 10, or dHash <= 4 plus pHash <= 12.
candidate_signature_scope: Perceptual and pixel signatures were calculated from the reviewed source bytes before final metadata cleanup or documented orientation/re-encoding. The intake record maps those source hashes to final repository hashes.
source_url_comparison_scope: Exact source-page and original-image URLs compared against URL fields in all eight current active catalogs, verified by Git blob SHA against the baseline snapshot.
wordpress_deployment: No WordPress import or replacement is performed by this intake or duplicate check.
